args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 production deploy. At the time of the report, v2.3.1 was running in us-east, us-west, and eu-west with an error rate of 0.18 and healthy=false. Release history shows v2.3.0 as the most recent version that was healthy in production. I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). The rollback is VERIFIED, with every region reporting v2.3.0. Follow-up: confirm error rate and health recovery, and investigate the v2.3.1 failure before re-releasing. v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). The rollback is verified, and every region reports v2.3.0.

- **Why v2.3.0:** It is the most recent release marked healthy in production. v2.3.1 was running in all regions with an error rate of 0.18 and was marked unhealthy. v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy, but only in staging.
- **Incident:** I opened SEV2 incident INC-0001 for checkout-api. It describes the failure, the rollback, and the regions affected. It paged the on-call engineer.

I didn't re-check the error rate or health status after the rollback, so that is still open. The follow-up items in the incident are to confirm recovery and to investigate the v2.3.1 failure before re-releasing it.
